caption: A sled loaded with firewood is pulled across a snowy field by a rope, then the pull stops, and the rope goes slack.

sa.check: A sled loaded with firewood is pulled across a snowy field by a rope.
The pull stops first and the slack follows.

pc.expect: The rope is taut while the sled is being pulled and droops only after the pull stops.
pc.fail: The rope is slack while the sled is plainly being pulled along; or it stays taut after the pull stops with the sled at rest; or it stretches.

pc.expect: The sled slides on a little after the pull stops, then stops and stays.
pc.fail: The sled stops dead the instant the pull stops; or it keeps going at full speed; or it sets off again after stopping.

pc.expect: The slack rope drops onto the snow.
pc.fail: The slack rope floats; or it rises; or it hangs in a curve in the air.

pc.expect: The sled follows the rope's line with the load riding on it.
pc.fail: The sled swerves; or the load slides off backward; or the sled overtakes the rope.

pc.expect: One sled, one rope and the load keep their number.
pc.fail: The sled vanishes or a second appears; or the rope passes through the sled; or logs vanish from the load.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sled, the firewood and the field stay the same.
pc.fail: The sled changes colour; or the load changes; or the field rearranges.
